thread:
incident-bot: ALERT 2061123456 - smart-routing: cross-region failover spike + retries :rotating_light:

ops-oncall: getting alerts for a big 5xx surge and failover traffic. graph shows traffic doubling into us-east-1 and us-west-2.

maya: digging in. I see repeat flow:
```
router: evaluate -> fallback -> pick redwood-v2-quant (us-west-2)
proxy: 503 from target -> trigger failover
client: immediate retry -> sends to router again
```

samir: config note — earlier today a canary enabled "fallback_immediate=true" on the routing policy. There was no quarantine or concurrency cap.

leah: customer impact: multiple Hosted API keys in APAC/EU saw increased latency and timeouts. Preliminary: ~9 customers affected, peak 5xx +140% for 12m.

andrew: mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-region fallback globally 2) set circuit-breakers on quant variants 3) apply sticky regional routing for top customers 4) shorten client retry window via header override

ops-oncall: applying global flag now:
```
POST /admin/flags
{ "smart_routing.fallback_enabled": false }
```

ops-oncall: flag is live.

samir: applying CB to redwood-v2-quant variants:
```
/infra/cb set --variant redwood-v2-quant --threshold 60rps --duration 20m
```

maya: metrics show error rate falling in eu-west-1 within 90s. Some backlog in frontends persists due to clients retrying.

elaine: raising support tickets: sent short interim note to affected customers. They want ETA and root cause.

leah: enabling sticky routing for top 3 keys now to stop cross-region churn.

andrew: handing pager to @andrew at 2061123600 (10m handoff). Leaving playbook notes: fallback off, CBs applied, sticky routing set, support informed.

andrew: ack. Follow-ups:
- runtime: add `failover_quarantine_ms` default 30000
- router: enforce `max_concurrent_failovers=1`
- sdk: default retry-backoff >=200ms, max_retries=3

samir: building patch and will ship a canary (10%) with quarantine + capacity check before routing.

maya: severity P2 (multiple paying customers impacted). elapsed ~24m. estimated fix + canary 75-120m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2061123456 updated: mitigations applied, handoff to andrew. Postmortem owner assigned: leah.

andrew: creating Jira INF-5012 routing failover quarantine + SDK backoff guard. Will coordinate with runtime for canary.

ops-oncall: note: root cause = canary-enabled immediate fallback + router not checking target capacity + aggressive client retries => thundering herd. Action items: config validation guard, deploy time check, SDK defaults.

maya: saving traces, logs, metric snapshots to incident folder. Attaching an example trace that shows retry amplification.

leah: drafting customer-facing summary. Numbers: peak 5xx +140% for 12m, ~9 customer keys >10% error rate, no data loss.

andrew: will keep mitigations for 3h post-canary if stable. plan to re-enable gradual fallback only after safety checks.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2061123456 - mitigation applied, handoff complete, postmortem scheduled.
